integrity: Explicit unconditional residue-progressions proof; exact finite verification is corroboration only; originality is a best-knowledge literature assessment and independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Only odd h congruent to 9 modulo 12 with h>=9; the theorem uses previously published strictness of the signed bound. Other odd orders and more than three stamps are not classified.
title: An exact odd-order stratum of the signed three-stamp problem
